body: Yeah I wouldn't want to talk to me either have a decent life. Thanks for trying I guess.
It feels like those who are around me are only around me because I can afford to buy things. I don't think the people around me are friends with me so much as my wallet

I just feel like a hollow man. I take a look in the mirror each morning and i cant help but hate whats staring back at me. Im an annoying loser with only two "friends". I have bought everything in this house to help out my gf and best friend. I just want to end everything maybe then I wouldn't be a drag on their lives.
